description: Na₂Te₂O₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 25°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.77 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-27°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.54 Å. There are two inequivalent Te sites. In the first Te site, Te is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.42 Å. In the second Te site, Te is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-2.19 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Te atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Te₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two Te atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Te atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Te atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Te atom.
